resume: Contenu original – licence CC BY-SA 4.0. Parler de cinéma et de célébrités, guider une visite de musée, et choisir ses vacances ou présenter une offre touristique.
notions: Culture et loisirs : mise en situation
Culture et loisirs : adjectifs et adverbes
Culture et loisirs : expressions et mots de liaison

sections.contenu:
*Welcome to the city museum. Today's **guided tour** lasts about an hour. We will start with the **permanent collection**, then visit the temporary **exhibition** on video-game design. Please do not touch the **artworks**, and photos without flash are allowed.*

*— What did you think of the film?*
*— The **plot** was a bit slow, but the **cast** was amazing and the **soundtrack** was **breathtaking**. I'd definitely **recommend** it.*
notions: Culture et loisirs : mise en situation

sections.contenu:
| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **to recommend** | recommander | *I'd recommend this series to anyone.* |
| **to release** | sortir (un film, un album) | *The film was released in May.* |
| **to sightsee / to go sightseeing** | visiter (en touriste) | *We went sightseeing in Lisbon.* |
| **to book** | réserver | *We booked a cottage by the sea.* |
| **to unwind** | se détendre | *I unwind by playing the guitar.* |
| **to star (in)** | jouer le rôle principal (dans) | *She stars in a new thriller.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **an exhibition** | une exposition | *The exhibition closes on Sunday.* |
| **a guided tour** | une visite guidée | *The guided tour starts at 10.* |
| **the plot** | l'intrigue | *The plot is hard to follow.* |
| **the cast** | la distribution (acteurs) | *The cast includes several newcomers.* |
| **a sequel** | une suite | *The sequel is better than the first film.* |
| **a getaway** | une escapade | *We're planning a weekend getaway.* |
| **accommodation** | l'hébergement | *Accommodation is included in the price.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **breathtaking** | à couper le souffle | *The view from the top is breathtaking.* |
| **overrated** | surestimé | *That film is overrated.* |
| **crowded** | bondé | *The beach was crowded in August.* |
| **off the beaten track** | hors des sentiers battus | *We prefer places off the beaten track.* |
| **worth (+ -ing)** | qui vaut la peine (de) | *The museum is worth visiting.* |
notions: Culture et loisirs : adjectifs et adverbes

sections.contenu:
| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **I'd definitely recommend it.** | je le recommande vivement | *Great restaurant; I'd definitely recommend it.* |
| **It's not my cup of tea.** | ce n'est pas mon truc | *Opera is not my cup of tea.* |
| **in my spare time** | pendant mon temps libre | *In my spare time, I play chess.* |
| **on the left / on your right** | sur la gauche / sur votre droite | *On your right, you can see the old harbour.* |
| **a must-see** | un incontournable | *The castle is a must-see.* |

cartes.recto:
Traduis en français : **to release**

*The film was released in May.*

Traduis en français : **to unwind**

*I unwind by playing the guitar.*

cartes.verso: **to recommend** — *I'd recommend this series to anyone.*

cartes.question: Complète : *The new album will be ___ next Friday.*
cartes.explication: *Release* = sortir. *Realise* est un faux ami (= se rendre compte).

cartes.recto:
Traduis en français : **the plot**

*The plot is hard to follow.*

Traduis en français : **a getaway**

*We're planning a weekend getaway.*

Traduis en français : **overrated**

*That film is overrated.*
Traduis en anglais : **qui vaut la peine (de)**

cartes.question: Complète : *This castle is really worth ___.*
cartes.explication: *Worth* est suivi de la forme en *-ing*.

cartes.recto:
Traduis en français : **It's not my cup of tea.**

*Opera is not my cup of tea.*
Traduis en anglais : **pendant mon temps libre**
cartes.verso: **in my spare time** — *In my spare time, I play chess.*

cartes.enonce: Présente en anglais, en deux phrases de guide, une salle de musée consacrée à des affiches de cinéma anciennes.
cartes.reponse: *On your left, you can see our collection of vintage film posters. Some of them are more than a hundred years old and absolutely breathtaking.*
